rejectedTopics: Tooling ownership for a private mould — valuable but lower-frequency than the selected first-order MOQ question.
Container loading optimization — overlaps the export-packaging and landed-cost guides.
Commercial dumbbell-set planning for gym use — already published in every active locale.
Custom-logo method comparison — existing multilingual content covers moulded, printed, engraved and end-cap options.
AQL acceptance sampling — published on the previous run and intentionally excluded from today's intent.
siteGaps: No existing article explains how a free-weight buyer separates a total-order minimum from per-weight, material, color, logo, packaging and shipment constraints in one comparable RFQ matrix.

searchRun.provider: Public Google- and Bing-visible result review, People Also Ask-style question review, Reddit buyer-language review, competitor review and direct primary-source verification
limitations: Quora blocked automated access; no answer text was used.
Reddit supplied buyer language only; identification, shipment-mass and trade-term statements rely on GS1, IMO and ICC.
Competitor minimum quantities were treated as supplier-specific and were not reproduced.
No customer, shipment, price, MOQ number, lead time, certification or performance result was inferred from public pages.
